newsitem.title: USA: CBOT old crop soybeans fall, Aug hits contract low.
newsitem.headline: CBOT old crop soybeans fall, Aug hits contract low.

text.p: CBOT old crop soybeans fell further in fast dealings near midday and a contract low was notched in the August as funds liquidated, pit sources said.
The new low for the August is $6.63 per bushel. The previous low of $6.67 was set on November 12.
The July contract has fallen nearly $1.00 per bushel in two days. That contract peaked at $7.97 a bushel on Monday and traded as low as $7.03-1/2 Wednesday.

Traders cited massive fund and speculative liquidation tied to ideas pressure was easing on tight old crop supplies. Persistent rumors that a commercial firm intended to deliver soybeans against the July further weighed on the spot month.
At 1204 CDT, soybean futures were down 20 cents per bushel to up one with July off 20 at $7.12.
